subject: Shinyapps with private packages... (packrat?, github private repos?)

messages.subject: Shinyapps with private packages... (packrat?, github private repos?)
parts:
Hi
I am very interested in deploying apps with private packages.
I am aware that for shinyapps app deployment, we can only use public repos on github.

I am wondering if there is a way around this by deploying self contained apps using packrat. Is this possible?
Are you planning to allow private github repos any time soon?

Best
Juan Pablo

messages.subject: Re: Shinyapps with private packages... (packrat?, github private repos?)
parts:
I have just tried to deploy an App that uses packrat for package dependencies and I get the following error:

Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'testpkg'
  
  The package was installed locally from source. Only packages
  installed from CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub are supported.


I guess shinyapps.io is not yet working with bundled package dependencies using packrat. Is that right?

Any ideas for a work around to use private packages in shinyapps.io?
Maybe installing from a source located in some static web page? would that be possible?

Best
